sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the self-nullification of "Mah" is the essential bittul from the essence of the soul, which is hidden and revealed through a higher arousal, specifically through the hundred blessings and Moshe.

translations.translation: Now, it is explained in the discourses of the Tzemach Tzedek
regarding the explanation of the verse "What does G-d ask of you,"
that "Mah" (what) is self-nullification,
like "and we are what,"
and it is the essential self-nullification that is above intellect, which comes from the essence of the soul.
And the explanation of "What does G-d ask of you" is that G-d asks of you the self-nullification of "Mah."
For this self-nullification of "Mah" that exists in every Jew from the essence of the soul
is in a state of concealment,
[and this concealment is not only because the animal soul conceals and hides this self-nullification,
but also because in its own essence it is hidden,
since it is above revelation],
and G-d asks of you
(from every Jew)
that the "Mah" within him should be revealed.
And this is also what the verse continues with: "to fear the L-rd,"
because the root of the self-nullification of fear,
even of lower fear,
is the essential self-nullification from the essence of the soul,
the self-nullification of "Mah."
And it is known
the difference between fear and love,
that love, since its existence has its root in the revelations of the soul,
while fear, since it is self-nullification, has its root in the essence of the soul.
And this is what the Gemara questioned: "Is fear then a small matter?"
Even though the fear in this verse is the fear that leads to the fulfillment of the commandments
(as explained in the verse "to fear the L-rd your G-d, to walk in all His ways"),
and regarding the love that leads to the fulfillment of the commandments, it is explained in Tanya
that this is easy for every person,
because love depends on comprehension,
and therefore,
through contemplation,
it is easy for every person to attain the love that leads to the fulfillment of the commandments.
However, fear is not so,
since it comes from the self-nullification of the essence of the soul, which is above intellect,
it is impossible to attain it
through contemplation,
"Is fear then a small matter?"
And in order to reveal the "Mah" of the soul,
the root of fear,
it is through a bestowal of power from above,
an influence from above the chain of descent, where man's service does not reach.
And this is that through the hundred blessings one attains fear,
for "hundred" is in Keter,
and through the hundred blessings,
and especially through the blessing over the commandments,
it is the drawing down of an arousal from above that an arousal from below does not reach,
through which drawing down the "Mah" of the soul is revealed
[do not read "Mah" but rather "Me'ah" (hundred)],
and through this one comes to fear.
And this, regarding Moshe, was a small matter,
because the drawing down of the arousal from above that an arousal from below does not reach is
(primarily)
through Moshe.
And as is known,
that the Torah,
the Torah of Moshe,
is an arousal from above that is above an arousal from below.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section adds that the arousal from above through Moshe (Torah) has an advantage over that through the hundred blessings, as it is drawn internally, producing a more internal fear.

translations.translation: And one may add,
that there is an advantage in the drawing down of the arousal from above that is through Moshe,
the Torah,
over the drawing down that is through the hundred blessings.
For the Torah is the aspect of inwardness.
Therefore, the drawing down of the arousal from above that comes through the Torah
is drawn into the inwardness
(similar to the arousal from above that is drawn through service).
And therefore,
also the fear that is drawn through this
is a more internal feeling.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that both "Mah" and "Me'ah" have advantages over each other, with "Mah" being hidden and revealed by "Me'ah," yet the revelation of "Me'ah" is for the sake of "Mah," which has a higher quality.

translations.translation: And based on this, it can be said,
that "Mah" and "Me'ah,"
each one has an advantage.
For that the "Mah" is in concealment
and in order for it to come into revelation it is through the drawing down of the aspect of "Me'ah,"
a light that is above the chain of descent – this is because of the advantage of "Me'ah" over "Mah."
And therefore,
the word "Mah" indicates a small thing,
and "Me'ah" is the perfection of number
(as above in section 2).
But on the other hand,
that the light that is above the chain of descent
("Me'ah")
comes into revelation below in order to arouse and reveal the "Mah" of the soul – this is because of the advantage of "Mah" over "Me'ah."
And through the drawing down of the aspect of "Me'ah" to arouse the "Mah,"
an elevation is also added in the aspect of "Me'ah"
(as will be explained below in sections 8-9).
